Celebrities Showcase Elaborate Halloween Costumes

Numerous celebrities showcased creative and elaborate costumes to celebrate Halloween. Heidi Klum unveiled a giant severed hand costume, described as her goriest yet. Other notable costumes included Maya Jama's 'epic' outfit that drew significant fan attention, and Lisa Rinna's impersonation of Kylie Jenner. Celebrities like Jade Thirlwall and James Charles were also noted for their Halloween attire at events.
